title: The Quran's First Prayer Asks for One Thing. Its Next Sentence Hands It Over.
excerpt: Al-Fatiha ends by asking: 'guide us to the straight path' (ihdina, root h-d-y). After the opening letters of the next chapter, al-Baqarah's first sentence answers in the same root: 'This is the Book... a guidance (hudan) for the God-conscious' (2:2). Across the seam of the two chapters, a prayer for guidance is met, in the next breath, by the guidance itself.
seo_title: Al-Fatiha's Plea, Al-Baqarah's Answer: The Guidance Seam (1:6, 2:2)
seo_description: The Quran's opening prayer asks 'guide us' (ihdina, 1:6); the first sentence of al-Baqarah answers in the same root h-d-y: 'a guidance (hudan) for the God-conscious' (2:2). A corpus-verified reading of the munasaba seam between the Quran's first two chapters.
